root_cause.description: Run-Semantics invoked a Python command that wrote a JSON summary to stdout and then returned $false. PowerShell therefore emitted a multi-item success-stream collection (JSON string plus false). The expression if (-not (Run-Semantics)) evaluated the non-empty collection as truthy, so the intended abort did not execute.
root_cause.affected_pattern: boolean return value mixed with unsuppressed success-stream output from external commands

exposure_effect.governance_note: The full archive calendar was programmatically inspected for structural provenance despite Stage A failure. This exposure must be preserved in the dataset ledger and cannot be relabeled as never-accessed. It does not convert Stage B into valid scientific promotion evidence.

required_remediation: Gate continuation by reading the persisted Stage A receipt field semantic_probe_pass rather than by function truthiness.
Gate final success by reading the persisted Stage B receipt status/common_complete_month_count.
Add regression checks preventing Stage B continuation after a failed Stage A receipt.
Preserve all existing receipts; do not delete or rewrite the failed Stage A receipt.
